gen-fs-oswald-gf-belgrano: Oswald stands tall and confident up top, its tightly knit rows hitting hard. Belgrano follows in a traditional serif with open curves, so a slightly larger body size would let it breathe.
gen-audiowide-manrope: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide spaces its glyphs with wide grout lines and no thick-thin shift. Manrope steps in as a friendly sans with bright open curves and a minimal step up from lowercase to capitals.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-alpino: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, with a low step from capitals to lowercase. Alpino's cozy, tall body is the draw.
gen-syne-gf-ovo: Ovo reads classic and authoritative, a serif whose thins stay only slightly lighter than its thicks. Syne, experimental and built from constant ink with a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, makes the strongest single impression.
gen-eater-fs-merriweather-sans: Eater turns dark and aggressive, with wide gaps between letters and thin strokes only slightly lighter than its stems. Merriweather Sans is the sturdy one.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-nunito: Round and bold, Autour One makes rings of its o with a constant wall and clear channels into each curve. Nunito is the friendly sans, finishing its terminals well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-quicksand: Wide, bold and commanding, Goldman sets its letters apart with generous clearance. Quicksand, a sans of blown-glass bowls and identical bar thickness, is the softer voice.
gen-gf-grandstander-fs-alpino: Alpino has a cozy, casual voice, with curve endings held well apart. Over many lines its tall body and short-looking ascenders make a relaxed texture beneath Grandstander's bold, heavy-diagonal headings.
gen-gf-offside-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk is lively yet neutral, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and bowls left unfinished on one side. Offside sits above it, widely tracked and unvarying in line thickness, so the two feel loosely linked.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-hind: Hind reads steady and neutral, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals, like a drawn string. Oxanium, with its high x-height and uninterrupted monoline strokes, gives that sans a commanding, distinctive headline partner.
